title: Finite abelian groups as finite products of cyclic groups
statement: Let $A$ be a finite abelian group, written multiplicatively. There exist a finite index set $I$, integers $d_i>1$ for $i\in I$, and a group isomorphism $$A\simeq\prod_{i\in I}(\mathbf Z/d_i\mathbf Z,+),$$ where each additive group of residue classes is regarded as a multiplicative group by renaming its operation. The index set may be empty. Here $\mathbf Z/d_i\mathbf Z$ is the quotient of the integer module $\mathbf Z$ by the submodule $d_i\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-pbc-quotient-module].
